title: Claude Code v2.1.78 — StopFailure Hook, Plugin Persistent State, Plugin Agent Frontmatter
description: Claude Code v2.1.78 (released ~March 17-18, 2026) introduces three new integrable features beyond what v2.1.77 added: (1) StopFailure hook event — fires when a turn ends due to an API error (rate limit, auth failure, etc.), enabling automated error recovery workflows without polling; (2) ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA} variable — plugin-scoped persistent state that survives plugin updates; /plugin uninstall now prompts before deleting it, enabling stateful plugin behaviors across sessions; (3) effort/maxTurns/disallowedTools frontmatter support for plugin-shipped agents — allows plugin authors to constrain agent behavior at definition time rather than relying on system prompts. Additional improvements: response text now streams line-by-line as generated (UX improvement for long-running tasks); terminal notifications now reach outer terminal when running in tmux with 'set -g allow-passthrough on'. Also v2.1.77/78 boundary: memory file last-modified timestamps (Claude can reason about which memories are fresh vs stale) and modelOverrides setting (maps model picker entries to custom provider model IDs, e.g., Bedrock inference profile ARNs) — exact version needs confirmation.

redundancy_check.notes: Registry last updated for v2.1.77. StopFailure hook not in registry (hooks section covers through Elicitation/ElicitationResult from v2.1.76). CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA and plugin agent frontmatter not in registry. modelOverrides and memory timestamps not in registry. All four features appear integrable.

evaluation.reasoning: Official Anthropic release with multiple genuinely novel features. StopFailure hook enables automated error recovery on rate limits/auth failures — directly useful for heartbeat/cron automation. Plugin agent frontmatter (effort/maxTurns/disallowedTools) improves agent constraint architecture. Memory timestamps let Claude reason about staleness. modelOverrides enables Bedrock/proxy routing. Integration complexity is low (built-in features, registry + docs update). Token efficiency is neutral but StopFailure prevents polling waste. Bundle evaluation: treat as one registry update covering all v2.1.78 features.
